{{Quote|The creation of more warriors will not end this war. The financial cost alone will bankrupt and cripple the Republic. By adding more clones to the conflict we are only escalating destruction, not winning the war. Which is why we ''must'' vote for this resolution. To promote more diplomacy, and bring an end to this killing and hatred.|Senator Padmé Amidala|<ref name="SM" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a coalition of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] proposed a '''bill to reduce military spending'''. The legislation was championed by Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] and Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], who drafted the document in response to a call for an increase in the mass production of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The call for increased production was initiated by Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in order to benefit her [[Planet/Legends|world]], which was the primary producer of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] at the time. Burtoni was supported by [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] Senator [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]], and together the two of them worked to quash Farr and Amidala's bill.

The Rodian and Naboo senators were joined in their campaign for the bill by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], and Farr's Rodian contemporary, [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]]. Although Farr was highly efficient in recruiting other Senators to vote for their bill, he and his comrades still faced an uphill battle against Burtoni's lobbying power and public opinion. Tragedy struck the coalition when Senator Farr was [[Death/Legends|killed]] as a result of [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]], prompting Amidala and Organa to begin an investigation into his death. Although Deechi was an early suspect, the Umbaran senator was himself killed, leading the two senators and legal authorities on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to believe that the leadership of the factions in support of and in opposition to the bill were targets for murder. Although Senator Burtoni was tagged as a suspect, it was later revealed that it was in fact Lolo Purs who had committed the murders.

After the revelation, Purs attempted to take Amidala hostage while escaping from the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Senate Annex building]], but was instead rendered unconscious by the Naboo Senator and taken into custody. In the aftermath of the incident, the bill was put to a vote and ultimately defeated, thus ensuring the continuation of the Clone Wars.
